Name: Early Game Eats
Author: tigerchatoyance
Description:
This mod features 6 recipes designed to help you with the early game struggle with stamina, all of which using easy to obtain forage! Each dish grants [b][color=#6aa84f]75 Energy[/color][/b], [b][color=#e06666]33 Health[/color][/b], a [b]5 minute buff[/b] to one of your skills or stats, and each craft makes 3 of the item. No kitchen or cookout kit needed!


~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
[size=4][b]Includes:[/b][/size]
[b]** Squirrel's Stash  **[/b]
1 Acorn, 2 Mixed Seeds
+1 Speed

[b]** Opossum Pot Pie **[/b]
1 Horseradish, 1 Oyster, 1 Carrot
+1 Farming

[b]** Raccoonatouille **[/b]
1 Spring Onion, 1 Horseradish, 1 Leek
+1 Foraging

[b]** Subterranean Trail Mix **[/b]
2 Bug Meat, 1 Cave Carrot
+1 Mining

[b]** Slime Surprise **[/b]
2 Slime, 1 White Algae
+1 Attack

[b]** Salty Stew of the Sea **[/b]
2 Clam, 1 Oyster
+1 Fishing
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ 
[size=4][b]Gift Tastes:[/b][/size]
Most villagers either dislike or outright hate most of these dishes, but a few of them like (or even love!) some of them! You can either find out yourself the tastes of each individual NPC at your own risk or you can click the spoiler below. Please note that only vanilla NPCs are specified but modded NPCs may still be affected by universals.

--[b][color=#ff7700]Disliked[/color][/b]: Universal

--[color=#ff7700][b]Disliked[/b][/color]: Universal

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~  

This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
Retextures used for the various forage pictured are [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21284]Vanilla Tweaks - Farming[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21433]Vanilla Tweaks - Aquarium[/url]

[b]TRANSLATORS:[/b] I don't have the energy to maintain an i18n file so please feel free to post your own translations as long as (1) this [b]original mod is linked to[/b] and (2) [b]no AI is used[/b] whether it be the translation itself or art assets.
